gen-nixie-one-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Nixie One draws every line at a single stroke width, a retro-tech wire with nothing to slow the eye. Zalando Sans Expanded follows with sparse, widely spaced letters and c tips that stay well apart; a bump in body size would suit that spacing.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpand: Nixie One feels nostalgic, all plain unshaded lines and open curves. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded sits beneath it with a modern, businesslike look, its c, e and s mouths open wide, so the old-tech heading and the newer text keep a clear line between them.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei has a modest shift from stem to serif. Nixie One above it keeps one unvarying stroke with a retro-tech mood, so the body gains a little more shape than the heading ever shows.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Zen Kaku Gothic Antique reads modern and tidy, its t crossbar matching the stem. Nixie One heads it with open, wire-thin retro curves, and a body size a notch above the default would let those smooth bends breathe against the display line.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Approachable is the first word for Zen Kaku Gothic New, whose open-mouthed curves stay clear and whose strokes have no hairlines or swells. Nixie One adds the nostalgic heading, and a long read goes smoothly.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Nixie One brings a nostalgic, retro-tech wire of open curves and one constant stroke. Zen Maru Gothic takes over below as a plain sans, contemporary and unsnagged by closed bowls, so the eye follows one thread from heading to text.
gen-nixie-one-ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans feels technical yet approachable, with a wide channel into every bowl. Nixie One above it is tubular and wire-like, and IBM Plex Sans is a good fit for a slightly larger body size if the heading looks fragile beside it.
gen-orbitron-fs-chillax: Relaxed is what Chillax feels like under Orbitron's precise, minimal heading. Chillax uses looping curves that lift off before closing, and if Orbitron were shrunk, its widely spread letters would lose their clear, large e eyes.
gen-orbitron-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Orbitron stretches its minimal, precise letters far apart along the line, each e showing a large clear eye. Pilcrow Rounded packs in tightly beneath, warm and tall, its curves refusing to close.
gen-orbitron-fs-roundo: Roundo is a neutral, geometric sans-serif with matching arch and stem on its n. Orbitron's high lowercase sits above that moderate body, and its wide-spread letters give the text a spacious header to lean on.
